#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# scripts/create-review-org.sh
#
# Creates a disposable scratch org for reviewing a feature, deploys metadata,
# assigns the Sales_Ops permission set to the admin, imports sample data,
# generates an admin password, and prints the login URL.
#
# Usage: ./scripts/create-review-org.sh <org-alias>
set -euo pipefail

# Resolve the repository root so relative paths work no matter where the
# pipeline (or developer) invokes the script from.
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "${REPO_ROOT}"

if [[ $# -lt 1 ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <org-alias>" >&2
    exit 1
fi

ORG_ALIAS="$1"
DEV_HUB_ALIAS="devhub"
SCRATCH_DEF="config/project-scratch-def.json"
SOURCE_DIR="force-app"
DATA_PLAN="data/sample-data-plan.json"
PERMSET_NAME="Sales_Ops"
DURATION_DAYS="3"
WAIT_MINUTES="20"

echo "Creating review scratch org '${ORG_ALIAS}' (expires in ${DURATION_DAYS} days)..."
sf org create scratch \
    --target-dev-hub "${DEV_HUB_ALIAS}" \
    --definition-file "${SCRATCH_DEF}" \
    --alias "${ORG_ALIAS}" \
    --duration-days "${DURATION_DAYS}" \
    --wait "${WAIT_MINUTES}"

echo "Deploying ${SOURCE_DIR} to ${ORG_ALIAS}..."
sf project deploy start --target-org "${ORG_ALIAS}"

# The user authenticated against a freshly created scratch org is its
# system administrator.
ADMIN_USERNAME="$(sf org display --target-org "${ORG_ALIAS}" --json \
    | grep -m1 -o '"username": *"[^"]*"' \
    | sed 's/.*"username": *"//; s/"$//')"

echo "Assigning permission set '${PERMSET_NAME}' to admin user '${ADMIN_USERNAME}'..."
sf org assign permset \
    --target-org "${ORG_ALIAS}" \
    --name "${PERMSET_NAME}" \
    --on-behalf-of "${ADMIN_USERNAME}"

echo "Importing sample data from ${DATA_PLAN}..."
sf data import tree --target-org "${ORG_ALIAS}" --plan "${DATA_PLAN}"

echo "Generating password for admin user '${ADMIN_USERNAME}'..."
sf org generate password --target-org "${ORG_ALIAS}"

LOGIN_URL="$(sf org display --target-org "${ORG_ALIAS}" --json \
    | grep -m1 -o '"instanceUrl": *"[^"]*"' \
    | sed 's/.*"instanceUrl": *"//; s/"$//')"

echo
echo "Review scratch org '${ORG_ALIAS}' is ready."
echo "Username:    ${ADMIN_USERNAME}"
echo "Login URL:   ${LOGIN_URL}"
echo

public with sharing class ContactEmailMatcher {
    /**
     * Input for matching a single email address to a Contact.
     */
    public class Request {
        @InvocableVariable(required = true)
        public String email;
    }

    /**
     * Output containing the Id of the matched Contact (or null when there is no match).
     */
    public class Result {
        @InvocableVariable
        public Id contactId;
    }

    /**
     * Matches each request email to a Contact, ignoring case and leading/trailing
     * whitespace. When several Contacts share an email, the one created first is used
     * (earliest CreatedDate, then lowest Id). Returns exactly one Result per Request,
     * in the same order, using at most one SOQL query no matter how many requests are
     * received.
     */
    @InvocableMethod(label = 'Match Contact by Email')
    public static List<Result> match(List<Request> requests) {
        List<Result> results = new List<Result>();
        if (requests == null) {
            return results;
        }

        // Reserve one Result per Request so count and order are preserved.
        // contactId defaults to null (no match / blank email).
        for (Integer i = 0; i < requests.size(); i++) {
            results.add(new Result());
        }

        // Normalize every non-blank email and group request indices by normalized email.
        Map<String, List<Integer>> indicesByEmail = new Map<String, List<Integer>>();
        Set<String> queryEmails = new Set<String>();

        for (Integer i = 0; i < requests.size(); i++) {
            Request request = requests[i];
            String email = (request == null) ? null : request.email;
            if (String.isBlank(email)) {
                continue;
            }
            String normalized = email.trim().toLowerCase();
            if (String.isBlank(normalized)) {
                continue;
            }
            List<Integer> indices = indicesByEmail.get(normalized);
            if (indices == null) {
                indices = new List<Integer>();
                indicesByEmail.put(normalized, indices);
                queryEmails.add(normalized);
            }
            indices.add(i);
        }

        if (!queryEmails.isEmpty()) {
            // Single SOQL query. Email equality in SOQL is case-insensitive.
            Map<String, Contact> bestContactByEmail = new Map<String, Contact>();
            for (Contact contact : [
                    SELECT Id, Email, CreatedDate
                    FROM Contact
                    WHERE Email IN :queryEmails
                ]) {
                String normalized = (contact.Email == null)
                    ? null
                    : contact.Email.trim().toLowerCase();
                if (normalized == null || !queryEmails.contains(normalized)) {
                    continue;
                }
                Contact current = bestContactByEmail.get(normalized);
                if (current == null
                    || contact.CreatedDate < current.CreatedDate
                    || (contact.CreatedDate == current.CreatedDate
                        && contact.Id < current.Id)) {
                    bestContactByEmail.put(normalized, contact);
                }
            }

            // Write the winning contact Id back to every request that used this email.
            for (String normalized : indicesByEmail.keySet()) {
                Contact matched = bestContactByEmail.get(normalized);
                Id contactId = (matched == null) ? null : matched.Id;
                for (Integer index : indicesByEmail.get(normalized)) {
                    results.get(index).contactId = contactId;
                }
            }
        }

        return results;
    }
}
